title: Comprehensive Bearframe visual-art training checklist
summary: Character design is ADDITIONAL homework, not a replacement for existing pixel-art work. Train and evaluate all competencies together: native-scale pixel placement and cluster discipline, clean contours, anatomy and proportions, distinctive and appealing character/portrait design, shape language, strong silhouettes, expressive face/visor/helmet design, readable armor and materials, lighting and color, frame-by-frame animation timing and movement weight, articulated mechanical geometry, natural accumulated overgrowth and age/damage, and intentional Ghost Grid mechanical faults versus distinctive Echo Frame glitch behavior. Compare original reference designs to native-resolution sprites and portraits; document failures, revisions, and objective QC before production approval. Previous rough assets are practice only, not finished.
source: Founder correction to Auren pixel-art study scope, Nov 2026
